jobs_results.title: Software Engineer - Hyperconverged Infrastructure
jobs_results.description:
Quantum Corp. leads the world in helping organizations build modern, software-defined infrastructure that simplifies IT operations and accelerates digital transformation. Whether its delivering unified compute, storage, and networking for enterprise workloads, enabling seamless hybrid cloud deployments, powering mission-critical virtualized environments, or driving AI-ready hyperconverged infrastructure at scale, Quantum has the tools and technology to help you engineer the solution that works now - and scales for decades to come. You are applying to an exceptional team that contributes to enhancing our position as a proven global leader in hyperconverged and software-defined infrastructure.

We are seeking a high-caliber Senior HCI Software Engineer to join our Hyperconverged Infrastructure Team. In this role, you will be responsible for the core software stack that unifies compute, storage, and networking into a single, seamlessly managed platform: the HCI Software Stack. You will design, implement, and optimize the software layers that converge compute, storage, and networking resources into a unified, policy-driven infrastructure platform.

This is a full-stack infrastructure role requiring a passion for systems software, distributed resource management, and building platforms that make complex infrastructure simple to operate at scale.

Specific Duties Include But Are Not Limited To



HCI Platform Architecture: Design and maintain the core HCI software stack including the distributed resource scheduler, software-defined storage engine, and virtual networking fabric that underpin Quantum's hyperconverged appliances.Performance & Resource Efficiency: Profile and optimize resource contention across compute, storage, and network layers. Work with technologies like iSCSI, NVMe-oF, SR-IOV, and DPDK to minimize overhead and maximize workload density on shared HCI nodes.Fault Tolerance & Self-Healing: Implement and maintain features such as automatic node failure detection, live VM migration, distributed snapshot management, and self-healing storage policies to ensure continuous availability of HCI workloads.Virtualization & Workload Management: Develop and extend integrations with hypervisors (KVM, VMware, Hyper-V) and container runtimes (Kubernetes, Docker) to enable seamless workload placement, live migration, and QoS enforcement across the HCI cluster.Scale-Out & Lifecycle Management: Ensure the HCI platform scales linearly as nodes are added, automating data rebalancing, capacity expansion, and rolling software upgrades without disrupting running workloads.

Job Requirements

Minimum 8 years of experience in systems or infrastructure software development using C/C++, Go, Python, or equivalent languages.Experience with hypervisors (KVM, VMware vSphere, Hyper-V) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift) is a plus.Experience with software-defined networking (OVS, VXLAN, BGP) and Linux networking stack is a plus.Experience with HCI platforms such as Nutanix AOS, VMware vSAN, or Azure Stack HCI is a plus.Experience with AI/ML infrastructure workloads and GPU resource management is a plus.Experience with cloud integration (AWS Outposts, Azure Arc, Google Anthos) and hybrid cloud architectures is a plus.Ability to work in a team environment.Strong communication skills.Ability to work with a globally distributed team.Self-motivated, able to identify and solve problems on their own.Ability to collaborate cross functionally and integrate other components into the solution.Approach problems creatively and not just repeat the same mistakes made before them.Effective communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Desired Skills

Experience with Linux OS administration including kernel tuning, performance profiling (perf, eBPF), and HCI node lifecycle managementExperience using GIT.Experience using JIRA.

Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is passionate about simplifying infrastructure complexity, thrives at the intersection of hardware and software, and has hands-on experience designing or operating hyperconverged or software defined infrastructure environments.

jobs_results.title: Quantum Software Developer
jobs_results.description:
Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri Campus is inviting applications from qualified candidates for the post of Quantum Software Developer .

For details contact: hr-cybersecurity@am.amrita.edu

Apply Now



Job Title

Quantum Software Developer – AI/ML Quantum Computing



Location

Amritapuri, Kollam



Required Number

2



Qualification

Bachelor’s or Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI/ML Quantum Computing, Data Science



Job Description



We are seeking highly skilled Quantum Software Developers with a strong background in computer science and artificial intelligence/machine learning.



In this role, you will bridge the gap between advanced machine learning and fault-tolerant quantum computing.



Your primary mission will be to design, develop, and integrate AI/ML-driven decoding pipelines and predictive noise management modules into a production-grade Quantum Error Correction (QEC) and Quantum Error Mitigation (QEM) software appliance.



Key Responsibility



ML-Assisted Decoding: Design and implement trained neural network or graph-based models for small stabilizer and surface codes, integrating them via scalable, plug-and-play API interfaces.



Predictive Noise Modeling: Build adaptive error-suppression routines capable of processing live calibration data and simulated noise profiles to dynamically optimize circuit execution.



Performance Optimization: Benchmark machine-learning decoders against classical decoding algorithms to optimize decoding speed, accuracy, and computational overhead on the Rudra server backend.



Toolchain Integration: Develop modular software components that seamlessly ingest standard quantum circuits and automatically output hardware-optimized, error-resilient versions.



Job category

Project



Last date to apply

October 31, 2026

jobs_results.title: Quantum Software Engineer Intern
jobs_results.description:
Physics Wallah has an open Quantum Software Engineer Intern position in Amritsar for motivated freshers and final-year students. You will work on live quantum computing projects and finish with something you can genuinely talk about in interviews.

About the role
As a Quantum Software Engineer Intern at Physics Wallah, your core focus will be implementing and benchmarking quantum algorithms on simulators and hardware. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve.

What you'll do day to day
• Work on implementing and benchmarking quantum algorithms on simulators and hardware alongside the core team
• Use Qiskit, Cirq, Quantum Algorithm Design, Linear Algebra, Python on live, production-facing problems
• Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers
• Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive
• Collaborate across functions — engineering, product, design or business as the work demands
• Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards
• Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan

Skills you'll build
You will build practical, demonstrable experience in Qiskit, Cirq, Quantum Algorithm Design, Linear Algebra, Python, Quantum Circuit Simulation, Error Mitigation Techniques, Complexity Analysis, Scientific Computing (NumPy), Technical Documentation — the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished résumé, and every one of these skills is taught on the job.

Who should apply
Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.E./B.Tech (CSE/ECE), B.Sc/M.Sc (Physics / Mathematics / CS) or M.Tech based in or willing to work from Amritsar. You should be willing to learn Qiskit, Cirq, Quantum Algorithm Design and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory.

Internship details
This is a 3-month internship in Amritsar, Punjab, with a stipend of ₹45,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with a quantum algorithm implementation with benchmarked results. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion.

You will finish this internship with practical, demonstrable skills, real project work to point at, and a much clearer sense of how the industry actually operates day to day. Strong performers are considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) and a full-time role.

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to Physics Wallah's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Work on implementing and benchmarking quantum algorithms on simulators and hardware alongside the core team; Apply Qiskit, Cirq, Quantum Algorithm Design, Linear Algebra to live, production-facing problems; Document your work clearly for reviewers and stakeholders; Participate in reviews and act on the feedback you receive; Collaborate across engineering, product, design or business as required; Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.E./B.Tech (CSE/ECE), B.Sc/M.Sc (Physics / Mathematics / CS) or M.Tech — 2026 freshers & final-year students welcome; Working knowledge of Qiskit, Cirq, Quantum Algorithm Design (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Strong fundamentals in your discipline and clear problem-solving ability; Care with detail and the discipline to document your work; Clear written and verbal communication in English; Based in or willing to work from Amritsar, Punjab.

jobs_results.title: Quantum Engineer
jobs_results.description:
About Artificial Brain
Artificial Brain is a pioneering technology company at the forefront of quantum computing and artificial intelligence. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of innovation by developing cutting-edge quantum solutions integrated with quantum optimization and advanced machine learning techniques. Join our dynamic team in Bengaluru, Karnataka, to shape the future of quantum technology.


Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Quantum Engineer to join our R&D team in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The ideal candidate will have extensive expertise in both gate-based and annealing quantum computing approaches, combined with a strong background in machine learning. This role will focus on conducting advanced research and development to design, implement, and optimize quantum algorithms and systems for real-world applications.


Key Responsibilities
 Quantum Algorithm Development: Design and develop quantum algorithms using gate-based and annealing quantum computing frameworks to solve complex computational problems. Machine Learning Integration: Integrate quantum computing solutions with machine learning models to enhance the performance and scalability of AI-driven applications. Research & Development: Conduct cutting-edge research to explore novel quantum computing techniques, hybrid quantum-classical algorithms, and their applications. System Optimization: Optimize quantum circuits and annealing schedules for performance, scalability, and error mitigation on various quantum hardware platforms. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, software engineers, and physicists, to develop and deploy quantum-enhanced solutions. Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes of quantum algorithms and systems, ensuring robustness and accuracy in real-world scenarios. Documentation & Reporting: Document research findings, prepare technical reports, and present results to internal teams and external stakeholders. Stay Updated: Keep abreast of the latest advancements in quantum computing, machine learning, and related fields to drive innovation. 
Required Qualifications
Education
 Master’s or Ph.D. in Quantum Computing, Physics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
Experience
 2 years of hands-on experience in quantum computing, with expertise in both gate-based quantum computing (e.g., Qiskit, Cirq, or similar) and quantum annealing (e.g., D-Wave). Proven experience in applying machine learning techniques (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning) to real-world problems. Strong track record in research and development, preferably in quantum computing or a related field. 
Technical Skills
 Proficiency in the Python programming language. Familiarity with quantum computing frameworks (e.g., Qiskit, Cirq) and ML libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn). Knowledge of quantum hardware platforms and their limitations (e.g., IBM Quantum, Google Quantum, D-Wave). Experience with quantum machine learning (QML) algorithms Experience with hybrid quantum-classical algorithms and optimization techniques. 
Research Skills
 Ability to conduct independent research, analyze complex datasets, and publish findings in peer-reviewed journals or conferences. 
Soft Skills
 Strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication, and ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment. Ability to work with clients (on-site and off-site) 
Why Join Artificial Brain
 Innovative Environment: Work on groundbreaking projects at the intersection of quantum computing and artificial intelligence. Impactful Work: Contribute to transformative technologies that have the potential to revolutionize industries. Growth Opportunities: Access to continuous learning, professional development, and collaboration with world-class experts. Inclusive Culture: Be part of a diverse and inclusive team that values creativity, curiosity, and innovation. 
Location
 This position is based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with opportunities for on-site work in the U.S., depending on project requirements.
